correctness.rationale: The polarized symmetric polynomial has d independent first derivatives for every d>=2,m>=3, establishing all flattening ranks. A determinant-one diagonal one-parameter subgroup assigns strictly positive weights to every monomial, with the sole exceptional (3,3) case handled by (2,0,-2); the resulting SL_d^m limit is zero. Any positive central semi-invariant is SL-invariant and thus vanishes at such a null-cone tensor, so it is not GIT semistable. Every full-rank bilinear tensor is an invertible matrix carried by GL_d^2 to the moment-map solution I_d. Direct integer finite checks from the embedded checker passed; no infinite conclusion relies on enumeration.
